summary: Add a real-Store control for production journal-prune outer rollback with two fixture consumers.

replay.detail: Fixture-only test; no startup replay, backfill or production mechanism.

schema.detail: No DDL, index, trigger, migration or library change.

rules.detail: Unchanged Installer code selects the cutoff and deletes journal references inside the caller transaction; no image deletion or policy change.

compatibility.detail: One authored, unrun control checks actual within-transaction journal/counter changes, committed WAL isolation, explicit rollback conservation and a predetermined committing arm. Existing controls and ceilings are unchanged. No performance, work-bound or adoption claim.

recovery.detail: No hook, retry, restart or cleanup policy change. Two-consumer refused COMMIT, crash/reopen, image reclamation, work accounting and failed-cleanup containment remain unverified.
